beats.title: Wanted posters and march to the Glimmering Globe
beats.summary: During the party at the Copper and Quartz, Bonogo uses paper acquired earlier in the city to make wanted posters of the hooded figure and hangs some around the inn. Stafl whips up the crowd and leads them down the street to the Glimmering Globe for the Bardic Storytelling Competition, with Caelynn hyping the crowd, Bonogo spotting the hooded figure from the top row, and Baergrom working a group of dwarves.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-12:c702e71fdf13:span:c702e71fdf13:14-14
anchor_quotes: Bonogo, using the paper he acquired earlier in the city, makes some “Wanted” posters of the hooded figure.
Stafl then whips the crowd up and he leads them down the street to the Glimmering Globe for the Bardic Storytelling Competition.
Caelynn moves through the crowd getting them involved and hyped up.
Bonogo takes the opportunity to view the seats from the top row and, for only a brief second, sees the hooded figure down in the front.
Baergrom joins a group of dwarves, attempting to sway them to Stafl.

beats.title: Dustwalker revealed and battle erupts at the competition
beats.summary: On stage Stafl calls out the competitors, including a shadowy figure later identified as the Dustwalker. When Bonogo throws daggers at the Dustwalker and they are intercepted by red-cloaked attendants, Caelynn calls the guard, who contacts Lesandra through a rocky-talky, and the battle begins.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-12:c702e71fdf13:span:c702e71fdf13:16-16
anchor_quotes: Stafl asks about the shadowy figure. He is informed that it is the Dustwalker!
Bonogo immediately throws a dagger at the Dustwalker, but is intercepted when one of his red cloaked entourage jumps in front of the dagger.
Caelynn then runs to the guard, asking for them to contact Lesandra through their “rocky-talky”.
He connects with the city’s twin operators, Sara and Frank, and asks for help. Then the battle begins.

beats.title: Fight against the Dustwalker and the Crimson Chorus
beats.summary: Bonogo lands dagger and sword hits on the poisoned Dustwalker while Caelynn's Snowball kills half the red cloaks, later revealed as the Crimson Chorus. The Dustwalker's guitar string snaps, then he charms the crowd with Word of the Shepherd along with Karsemine and Baergrom, who break free. The red cloaks hurt Bonogo badly, Ephanna Haxes the Dustwalker, and Stafl uses Suggestion and Celestial Revelation with Necrotic Shroud to clear and block the crowd.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-12:c702e71fdf13:span:c702e71fdf13:18-18
anchor_quotes: The Dustwalker took a good amount of damage from the dagger throw, and is now also poisoned.
Caelynn casts Snowball on the group of red cloaks surrounding the Dustwalker, killing half of them with one spell.
He turns to the crowd around the front of the stage and casts Word of the Shepherd and the crowd becomes charmed, along with Karsemine and Baergrom.
The red cloaks, called the Crimson Chorus, cast a spell on Bonogo then attack him for big damage.
Stafl quickly uses Suggestion on the Half-Orc and the crowd near the stage and has the orc lead a large part of the audience up and out of the building.

beats.title: Dustwalker slain, then found alive in his cell
beats.summary: Caelynn's second Snowball kills the remaining red cloaks and the Dustwalker, leaving only goo that smells like cooked meat. Ephanna calms the panicking crowd and Lesandra arrives to take notes and advise the group to stay inside the city. Karsemine and Bonogo rush to the Academy, only to find the Dustwalker apparently still in his cell; they knock out a refusing city guard, open the cell, and Bonogo cuts the Dustwalker's throat, leaving another goo puddle before guards arrive.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-12:c702e71fdf13:span:c702e71fdf13:20-20
anchor_quotes: Caelynn again casts Snowball, killing all the remaining red cloaks. She also kills the Dustwalker!
Lesandra arrives and begins taking notes, starting with Caelynn. She advises the group to stay inside the city.
Karsemine and Bonogo, realizing that the Dustwalker must have broken out of his cell, rush to the Academy.
They discover the Dustwalker sitting in his cell, right where they left him!
In a flash Bonogo cuts his throat. Again, all that remains is a puddle of goo smelling of cooked meat.
